Subject: Intro: Omar Hassan — Senior Infra Engineer candidate (scouted referral)

Hi Karthik & team,

Hope you’re well — I wanted to introduce Omar Hassan, a senior infrastructure engineer I've been working with who is actively looking for roles focused on low-latency inference systems. He was the lead on a recent real-time serving project at his current company and comes with strong experience in GPU infra and latency tuning.

Omar — meet Karthik Iyer (Hiring Manager, Infra), Laura Bennett (Recruiting Ops), and Monica Patel (Talent Partner at Redwood). Omar is open to a fast-track interview process and Priya has marked this as priority.

I’ve attached his resume. If possible, could we kick off with a 45-min technical screen this week? Omar is on PST and has availability: Tue 12/22 10–12, Wed 12/23 14–17.

Priya

Attachments: Omar_Hassan_Resume.pdf

Karthik
